description: Historical Codico regressions. The agent works on the pre-fix commit; verifier tests are injected only after the run.

tasks.prompt: Fix streaming so an HTTP/SSE response that ends before a terminal completion marker is reported as an unexpected recoverable interruption instead of being silently accepted as complete. Keep normal completed streams unchanged.
tasks.testNamePattern: unexpected provider EOF is surfaced as a recoverable stream interruption

tasks.prompt: When an interrupted model stream resumes, prevent text from the end of the partial response from being repeated at the seam. Add a general overlap calculation rather than hard-coded string trimming.
tasks.testNamePattern: drops text a resumed response repeats from before the cutoff

tasks.prompt: Separate recoverable transport interruptions from ordinary provider or application errors so only genuine connection/stream interruptions trigger automatic continuation.
tasks.testNamePattern: only transport interruptions are auto-recoverable

tasks.prompt: Normalize provider-specific finish reasons so output-length cutoffs are consistently recognized while normal completion reasons remain normal.
tasks.testNamePattern: provider-specific cutoff reasons normalize for the UI

tasks.prompt: Prevent the agent from stopping when it merely announces an action such as reading or searching a file but emits no tool call. Detect this stalled-turn pattern conservatively so normal final answers are not treated as stalled.
tasks.testNamePattern: detects action announcements that were never followed by a tool call

tasks.prompt: Make tool parsing recover a tool call when the model reaches a clean end of response without writing the final closing fence. Do not execute genuinely incomplete streaming drafts early.
tasks.testNamePattern: finds a tool fence the model never closed

tasks.prompt: Improve repeated-tool loop detection so fingerprints include the tool arguments. Calls to the same tool with different paths, commands, or values must not be mistaken for identical repetitions.
tasks.testNamePattern: tool fingerprints distinguish calls by their arguments

tasks.prompt: Allow write_file content to contain Markdown code fences without truncating or corrupting the outer tool call. Preserve the exact inner content.
tasks.testNamePattern: write_file content may contain its own code blocks

tasks.prompt: Support a four-backtick outer tool fence so file content containing ordinary triple-backtick Markdown fences is parsed as content rather than as the end of the tool call.
tasks.testNamePattern: four-backtick tool fences treat inner fences as content

tasks.prompt: Make edit_file parsing preserve old/new strings that themselves contain Markdown code fences. The nested fences must not terminate the tool call.
tasks.testNamePattern: edit_file strings may contain code blocks

tasks.prompt: During streaming, do not consider a tool fence complete until its closing fence line is actually complete. Avoid premature execution when a closing delimiter is still fragmented.
tasks.testNamePattern: scanner waits for a complete closing line while streaming

tasks.prompt: Harden terminal execution so hung commands are terminated after the configured timeout and return a clear timed-out result instead of leaving a child process behind.
tasks.testNamePattern: terminal runner times out hung commands

tasks.prompt: Add provider-native tool-call parsing for OpenAI-style streamed tool calls where function arguments can arrive in arbitrary SSE fragments. Emit one structured call only after the arguments are complete.
tasks.testNamePattern: OpenAI tool-call fragments survive arbitrary SSE chunking

tasks.prompt: Ensure malformed or incomplete native tool arguments are never executed. Keep them pending or reject them safely until a valid complete JSON argument object exists.
tasks.testNamePattern: malformed native arguments remain pending instead of executing

tasks.prompt: Harden outbound URL fetching against SSRF. Reject loopback, private, link-local, cloud metadata, reserved, and documentation-only address ranges while still permitting public addresses.
tasks.testNamePattern: blocks loopback, private, link-local, metadata and reserved addresses

tasks.prompt: Prevent SSRF through hostnames that resolve to private infrastructure. Validate every DNS answer, not just the literal hostname or first result.
tasks.testNamePattern: rejects DNS names that resolve to private infrastructure

tasks.prompt: Close the DNS-rebinding gap in public URL fetching by connecting to the already validated DNS result instead of performing a second uncontrolled resolution at connect time.
tasks.testNamePattern: pins requests to the validated DNS result

tasks.prompt: Stop MCP child processes from inheriting the extension host's entire environment. Pass only a minimal safe runtime environment plus variables explicitly configured for that MCP server.
tasks.testNamePattern: MCP children do not inherit arbitrary parent secrets

tasks.prompt: Make the terminal process runner honor AbortSignal cancellation promptly and clean up the spawned process rather than waiting for natural exit.
tasks.testNamePattern: terminal runner honors user abort

tasks.prompt: Normalize fetched HTML into readable text without leaking script/style executable content, and decode common HTML entities correctly.
tasks.testNamePattern: HTML normalization strips executable/style content and decodes common entities

tasks.prompt: Preserve provider-native tool calls and results in conversation history for OpenAI-compatible providers. The assistant tool call id and subsequent tool result tool_call_id must remain linked across turns.
tasks.testNamePattern: OpenAI history preserves tool call id and tool result linkage

tasks.prompt: Preserve Anthropic native tool history across turns using tool_use followed by the matching tool_result instead of flattening completed calls into fake user text.
tasks.testNamePattern: Anthropic history emits tool_use followed by tool_result

tasks.prompt: Preserve Gemini native function call history across turns using functionCall and matching functionResponse structures.
tasks.testNamePattern: Gemini history emits functionCall followed by functionResponse

tasks.prompt: When a provider is using fenced compatibility mode, convert prior native tool turns into readable compatibility text instead of sending unsupported native structures.
tasks.testNamePattern: compatibility transports flatten native tool turns to readable text

tasks.prompt: Apply the public-network safety policy to browser automation requests so private, loopback, link-local, metadata, redirect, and subresource HTTP(S) requests are validated by default.
tasks.testNamePattern: browser policy validates every HTTP(S) request when private access is disabled

tasks.prompt: Add an explicit opt-in that lets browser automation bypass public-network validation only when the private-network setting is enabled. The secure default must remain blocked.
tasks.testNamePattern: browser policy bypasses public-network validation only after explicit opt in
